Several weeks (the missions depend on the stage of the Deeplings world change)

The scientist {npc:Spectulus} discovered a strange island and a giant staircase leading to a world beneath the sea. Follow his notes to {wiki:Gray Beach}, enter {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja} and take part in the missions of the Deeplings world change: sea hearts for the god-king Qjell, purification of Deepling Spawns, coral mines and the Deepling Guardian bosses. You earn the {wiki:Deepling Outfits|Deepling Outfits} with both addons, access to the deepest zones of Fiehonja, random prizes and several achievements.
Spectulus has discovered a strange island.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 130+** (the Deeplings come in big groups and the bosses require a team).
The missions depend on the **stage of the {wiki:Deeplings|Deeplings} world change** on your server (see the table in section 3).
For the 1st addon you need to have done the Coral Mine (10 crates) in stage 2 and killed the bosses in stage 3, or buy the three treasures from the Deepling Guardians.
For the 2nd addon you need a {item:Small Golden Anchor} (rare drop from the Soul Net mission).

The missions **do not depend on each other**: you can do any of them without having done the previous ones. What matters is the current stage of the Deeplings world change on your server.
The Guide NPCs tell you which stage the server is in (see the quoted lines at the start of each stage).
Do the shortcut first (Gray Beach ↔ Fiehonja teleport): it saves you a lot of time in every mission.
If you buy the Seashell Books from other players, make sure they have **bloodstains**: there are similar books in the Fiehonja library that are useless.
1. The First Visitor — get to Gray Beach and talk to Spectulus

Take a boat to **Gray Island**. There are only connections from the ports of {wiki:Ab'Dendriel}, {wiki:Venore}, {wiki:Darashia} and {wiki:Edron}. Talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land next to {npc:Scrutinon}.
Talk to Scrutinon and go down the hole
If you like, talk to {npc:Scrutinon} to learn more about {wiki:Quirefang}. When you are ready, enter the hole **south** of Scrutinon.
Gray Island — path to Gray Beach
On floor -1, head **northeast** through the underground passage and enter the {item:Water Vortex}.
The Water Vortex in the underground passage

You appear on the other side of the cave (Gray Beach entrance). Use the {item:Rope} on the rope spot to climb up. Then go **north** until you reach Gray Beach. To the **northwest** there is a depot and a temple.
Go **east** and enter a hole. In this cave there are a {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} and Spectulus's {item:Strange Machine}.
Gray Beach — hole to the east that leads to the machine
The Strange Machine in the cave
The Strange Machine cave with the chest
Open the chest and read the notes
Open the chest to receive the {item:Notes and Coordinates}. Use the notes: *"The scribblings seem to describe an underground machine. There are also some cryptic coordinates written on it."*

Use the {item:Soft Green Chair} on the machine. You get the message *"At least the instructions of the portable teleporter of this machine were readable in the strange notes you found!"* and are teleported to the **Ivory Towers**, in Edron.

In the Ivory Towers talk to {npc:Spectulus}: {key:hi}, {key:strange machine} and answer {key:yes} three times. He tells the story of the staircase, gives you the "upgrades" so you can walk underwater and **150 gp** to take the boat back to Gray Island.

You are in **Edron**. Go to the harbour and take the boat to Gray Island ({key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes}; Spectulus gave you the 150 gp). Then repeat the path from the previous steps: hole **south** of {npc:Scrutinon}, {item:Water Vortex} on floor -1 and {item:Rope} on the rope spot up to Gray Beach.
Do this route once to gain access to the teleport that links Gray Beach to the protected area of Fiehonja (next to the Qjell statue).
From Gray Beach, follow the coast **east** and enter the hole furthest **southeast**.
Go down the big staircase to the bottom.
At the bottom of the staircase follow the cave **south** to a ramp. Follow the one-way path to the main part of {wiki:Fiehonja|Fiehonja}.
Go up the ramp and enter the teleport

Walk **north** until you find a ramp going up to the north (there are two possible ones). Go up and keep going north to some stairs with a {item:Teleport|teleport}. Enter the teleport to gain access to the Fiehonja–Gray Beach shortcut. From now on the teleport in Gray Beach takes you straight to the protected area of Fiehonja (next to the Qjell statue), and this teleport on the stairs takes you back to Gray Beach: this is how you **leave** Fiehonja at the end of each mission.
The teleport in Gray Beach takes you to the protected area of Fiehonja (with the Qjell statue)
Access to the Gray Beach ↔ Fiehonja teleport
You can do this part at any time and in any stage. It is not needed to progress, but you need the outfit for addons 1 and 2.
Kill {creature:Deepling Spellsinger|Deepling Spellsingers} to loot {item:Key to the Drowned Library|Keys to the Drowned Library}.

Use the keys on the {item:Seashell Bookcase|Seashell Bookcases} in the two libraries (see image). Each bookcase gives a chance of one of the three books. You need all three: {item:Seashell Book (Blue)|blue}, {item:Seashell Book (Green)|green} and {item:Seashell Book (Yellow)|yellow}. Expect about **20 keys**, depending on luck.
The two libraries with Seashell Bookcases

The right books have **bloodstains**. The similar books from the Fiehonja library ({item:Seashell Book (Library Blue)}, {item:Seashell Book (Library Green)}, {item:Seashell Book (Library Yellow)}) are just reading books and are useless.
Go to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:book} and {key:yes}, three times (once per book). After the third one he gives you the {wiki:Deepling Outfits|Deepling Outfit}.
4. How the Deeplings world change works
The available missions depend on the stage of the world change. **200 points** (added up across the whole server) are needed to move on to the next stage.
Soul Net (5 points); killing 1 {creature:Deepling Guard} (1 point up to 100 points, then about 0.1)
Same as stage 1 + Coral Mine (2 points per coral box)
Same as stage 1. There is no next stage, but if 200 points are accumulated on the last day of stage 3, the world change goes back to stage 2 instead of stage 1

Line from the Guide NPCs in this stage: *"The creatures of the deep are currently hiding in the black waters beneath. If their god-king can be pleased with the treasures of the deep, a pathway may open [...]"*. This mission is not needed for the outfit or the addons: it is there so you have a chance to win a {item:True Heart of the Sea} and other prizes. You have to do it **5 times** to receive **any** prize.
In Gray Beach enter the teleport to Fiehonja. You appear near the {wiki:Qjell} statue.

To the **west-southwest** of the statue there is a ramp going down. Go down and follow the cave **northwest**. On the way you pass a {item:Strong Water Vortex} (you will use it later). For now, go **southwest** of the vortex through the small crevice with a {item:Warning Sign} at the entrance. Follow the narrow passage to a ramp going up: the crystal mine is up there.

The mine has 3 floors with lots of {item:Large Red Crystals}; you do not need to go far from the entrance. Use the {item:Pick} (or equivalent) on the crystals. One of three things can happen (and then you cannot mine for 30 seconds):

In a sample of 60 attempts: 13 gave a gem, 24 nothing and 23 a Deepling Guard. After you get a Rough Red Gem, you can only mine another once you have cut it and offered it (or after some time, possibly 24 hours).
Go back the same way and stop next to the {item:Warning Sign}. Use the {item:Rough Red Gem} on the nearby {item:Strong Water Vortex} to create a {item:Heart of the Sea}.
Use the Rough Red Gem on the Strong Water Vortex to get a Heart of the Sea
Return to the Qjell statue and use the {item:Heart of the Sea}, **from a distance**, on the gem slot in the statue's head. You may need to try a few times until you hit the right spot.
The Qjell statue with the big red gem

Repeat the mission **5 times** during stage 1 to get access to the prizes in the stage 2 library. When the server has handed in 100 hearts in total, a big shiny red gem appears on the statue and no more mining is possible until the next stage 1.
Handing in 100 hearts gives no extra prize and does not advance the stage: it is purely decorative. You can repeat this mission whenever the server goes back to stage 1.
6. Soul Net (stages 1, 2 and 3) — Small Golden Anchor
This mission gives **5 points** towards the world change progress and is the only way to get the {item:Small Golden Anchor} for the 2nd addon.
On the surface of Gray Beach, talk to {npc:Alternative Rock} and agree to help ({key:help}). He gives you a {item:Soul Net}.
Enter the Fiehonja teleport and leave the protected area by the ramp to the **north**. Follow the cave north and then always **east**; go up the ramp to the spawning site.
Spawning site: green = approximate position of the Deepling Spawns

Use the {item:Soul Net} on every pile of {item:Deepling Spawn (Cursed)}. You must purify **all** of them before the first one regenerates (about 2 minutes). Here there are only {creature:Deepling Worker|Deepling Workers} and {creature:Deepling Brawler|Deepling Brawlers}, which are fairly harmless.
If you go alone and below level 150, use speed items or spells.

You can repeat as many times as you like, but after the last purification you have to wait **5 minutes** until the spirits return. Rarely, when you purify the last spawn, you receive a {item:Small Golden Anchor}; otherwise you see *"The curse on the spawn has been lifted. All remaining evil spirits have fled from this place."*
In a sample of 9 attempts, 4 gave the anchor.
7. Stage 2 — Qjell's prizes and Coral Mine

Line from the Guide NPCs in this stage: *"God-king Qjell seems to be pleased, the floodgates to the Drowned Library have opened. However, a passage to reach the outer rim of the caves still has to be created. [...]"*

From the Qjell statue go **north**, down the ramp and keep going north, up another ramp. In stages 2 and 3 there is no longer a wall blocking the way. Keep going north to the library (there are {item:Seashell Bookcase|Seashell Bookcases} on the walls).
Stage 2 maps (library, prize room and Coral Mine)
From here on the Deeplings appear in large groups.

Go up the ramp and go **east** to another ramp. Go up once and go around the ramps to the **west** to a teleport. You can only enter if you handed in **5 or more** Hearts of the Sea in the last stage 1. Inside there is no danger: use the {item:Treasure Chest (Blue)} and the {item:Hoard of Gold|Hoards of Gold} on the floor.
Platinum Coins and three random prizes
It is confirmed that the same character can win the True Heart of the Sea several times.
Coral Mine — get to the deposits

Follow the path to the prize room, but **before** the teleport turn **north** into a corridor and go down some ramps leading out of the library. Go as far **east** as possible to a ramp (see map 4 of the previous image) and go up: you find deposits of {item:Fossilised Coral}.
Use the {item:Pick} on the deposits until you get a {item:Crate Full of Coral}. You can only have up to **3 crates** mined before you use them.
You get a Crate Full of Coral (121 in 1248 attempts)

Go back down the ramp and, about halfway to the library ramp, there is another ramp on the **south** side of the cave (map 4). Go up it: you find an unfinished ramp and a construction tile. Use the coral crate on the construction tile and then use the {item:Shovel} on the unfinished ramp; the crate disappears and you can mine again.
The construction tile and the unfinished ramp
Repeat until you have mined and handed in **10 crates**. This gives you access to the active Deepling boss when the server moves on to stage 3.

You cannot use other players' crates: access is counted by the crates **you** mine. If you lose a crate (e.g. it gets stolen), you have one fewer of the 3 allowed until the next day. If there are no coral deposits or the ramp is already finished, the server is in stage 3 and you can no longer gain access to the boss.
Access to a Deepling boss in stage 3

Line from the Guide NPCs in this stage: *"The inner arcanum of the deep has been breached. Now nothing can stop the assault on Qjell's dark guardians. [...]"*. The third zone of Fiehonja is open (the coral ramp is built), with {creature:Manta Ray|Manta Rays} and at least one of the three bosses ({creature:Tanjis}, {creature:Obujos}, {creature:Jaul}). The coral mine no longer has deposits.

The boss is chosen at random (most often {creature:Tanjis}, then {creature:Obujos} and lastly {creature:Jaul}) and stays for that day only; at server save it is drawn again (it can repeat). You have access **only once** to the current boss if you have mined the required crates. When you enter the boss teleport you can stay up to **20 minutes**; the boss appears 3 to 10 minutes later (depending on the players online). After killing it at least once, you can open the chest next to the lair for an extra prize.

You lose access to a boss room as soon as you get credit for killing one of them, but you can enter and leave while you have no credit. Trick: bring the boss down to red health, leave, re-enter to restart the 20 minutes and only then kill it, so you have time to get more kills.

When you open one of the 3 prize chests you lose access to the other bosses and (since version 10.38) to their chests. In practice you can only open 1 chest and kill 1 boss per stage 3 rotation. If you cannot open a chest, repeating the Coral Mine does not help: access only renews after you receive the prize.
If you do not fight a boss in the same rotation in which you did stage 2, the access is kept for a later rotation (each stage 1–3 cycle), even weeks later.
Get to the Golden Anchor (2nd addon)
With the {item:Small Golden Anchor} in your backpack, go to the stage 3 area and look for the {item:Golden Anchor}. Follow the maps in order, from step 1 to 5.
Use the {item:Small Golden Anchor} on the {item:Golden Anchor}. You are teleported to a room with the NPC {npc:Navigator}.

Say {key:hi} to {npc:Navigator} (he answers with an incomprehensible sentence) and you get the achievement **Navigational Error**. The answer to his riddle is {key:flou}. Then ask about the {key:helmet} and say {key:yes}: he swaps your Small Golden Anchor for the 2nd addon. (If you want to hear the whole story: {key:explain}, {key:yes}, {key:no}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}.)
The teleport in the room takes you back to the surface. Make sure team members without a Small Golden Anchor are strong enough to go back on their own.

Kill the bosses {creature:Obujos}, {creature:Tanjis} and {creature:Jaul} (one per stage 3 rotation) and open the respective chests. There is a chance of getting {item:Obujos' Shell}, {item:Tanjis' Sight} and {item:Jaul's Pearl}. Alternatively, buy the three from other players.
It is the hardest addon: the chances of each item dropping are very low. Having repaired the ramp 10 times in stage 2 is only the minimum requirement.
Hand the treasures to Rock Steady

In Gray Beach, talk to {npc:Rock Steady}: {key:hi}, {key:collect}, {key:yes} — repeat {key:collect} and {key:yes} until you have handed in all three items. Then say {key:collect} once more and he gives you the 1st addon. You also get the achievement **Spolium Profundis**.

At the end of each mission, return to the protected area by the Qjell statue and use the shortcut teleport to Gray Beach (there you have a depot and a temple). No boat docks at Quirefang: to leave the island, go down to the Gray Beach entrance, south of the village, and do the underground passage in reverse to Gray Island. There tell {npc:Scrutinon} {key:hi}, {key:passage} and the name of the city: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore.
The quest is also known as the **Deepling Outfit Quest** or **Quirefang Quest**.
Non-hostile creatures you will find underwater: {creature:Fish (Creature)|Fish}, {creature:Northern Pike (Creature)|Northern Pike}, {creature:Slippery Northern Pike} and {creature:Calamary}.
